tutorial_body_1: A survey party game for two families. Your phone runs everything as the host - the TV shows the board for everyone to see.
tutorial_body_2: Read the question out loud. The first player to buzz in answers first. Tap the family that buzzed, then tap the board row that matches their answer - or 'Not on the board'.
tutorial_body_3: The player with the higher-ranked answer decides whether their family plays the board or passes it to the other family. If neither answer is on the board, the families keep taking turns until one is.
tutorial_body_4: The family in control guesses the remaining answers one member at a time. A wrong answer, or running out of time, is a strike. Three strikes give the other family one chance to steal the whole pool.
tutorial_body_5: After the rounds, the leading family sends two players. The first answers five questions against the clock; the second answers the same five without repeating. 200 points wins.
tutorial_body_6: Pair with your TV, name the families, and start playing. Good luck!
